cards.title: Make it look like yours
cards.text: Pick the theme, accent colour, window material, corner style, density and motion in Settings. Changes show straight away.

cards.title: A new tray pop-up
cards.text: Click the tray icon for tiles with your battery at a glance. Use Edit to choose and reorder the tiles, and right-click the icon for a quick menu with the charge limit.

cards.title: Keyboard shortcuts
cards.text: Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+5 jump between the pages, and Ctrl+, opens Settings. Hover a page in the list to see its key.

cards.title: Better for screen readers
cards.text: Buttons, tiles and the battery ring now have clear names, so a screen reader says what each one does.
